name: Stable Audio
tagline: Stable Audio is Stability AI's generative AI tool for creating original music tracks and sound effects from text prompts. It generates high-quality stereo audio up to several minutes long and is designed for musicians, sound designers, and content creators seeking royalty-free audio.
